ATK +100%; Stops attacking and continuously channels to alter the field: every 2.67 seconds, summons “Flame Clusters” traveling along 5 rows facing her direction; “Flame Clusters” explode when hitting an enemy to deal 100% of ATK as AoE Arts damage, and if the enemy is under Burn burst, deals Elemental damage instead
Overload: “Flame Cluster” summoning interval is reduced to 2 seconds, and the range expands to up to 13 rows
If a target is hit by multiple “Flame Clusters” from the same wave, subsequent ones only deal 15% damage
Skill can be manually deactivated
